hook: How does one agent use a local tool and a remote CRM without custom glue for each?
bullets: Two MCP servers: fs over stdio, crm over http
The SDK client discovers tools with tools/list
Tools are named mcp__server__tool, gated by allowed_tools
Claude calls lookup_customer, the client routes tools/call
Grounded answer in a single turn
